facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that on 7 October 2024 Ghana launched CADIS, which verifies identity by scanning the Ghana Card and entering a phone number, with biometric single sign-on drawing on National Identification Authority data.

Vice President Bawumia said the CADIS app gives access to several public services in one place through one biometric single sign-on, including civil registration, passports, driver's licences, tax filing, business and vehicle registration and health insurance.
Biometric Update describes the CADIS mobile app as providing digital ID, with users verifying their identity in the app by Ghana Card scan and phone number to create a digital ID.

systems.owner: Office of the President with the Ghana Revenue Authority
